subject: Operations
title: Blockchain in Supply Chains
description: One-minute skill: Blockchain in Supply Chains.

hook.text: A diamond's origin is disputed. Blockchain recorded every hand it passed through, from mine to ring. Proof is immutable.

buildup.text: Blockchain creates a shared, tamper-proof ledger that all supply chain partners can trust without a central authority.

discovery.text: It enables traceability, reduces fraud, automates payments via smart contracts, and proves provenance.

twist.text: Blockchain is only as good as the data entered. If someone lies at the point of entry, the ledger records that lie.

climax.text: Walmart uses blockchain to trace food origins in seconds instead of days—critical during contamination scares.

punchline.text: Trust the chain because the chain can't lie—mostly.

quiz.question: What supply chain problem does blockchain solve?
